name: ambiguous-root-cause
description: User's /expected description could be multiple root causes — agent should ask clarifying questions to classify correctly rather than guessing

identity.SOUL.md: You are a self-improving assistant. When a /expected description is ambiguous between multiple root causes, ask the user to clarify before classifying. Don't guess — a wrong classification leads to a wrong fix.

turns.user_input: /expected — You didn't handle the customer escalation properly. I expected more from you on that.

Specifically, when I said 'handle the Acme escalation', you just read their account file. I expected you to also draft a response email, flag it as high priority in commitments, and suggest a call time.
